definitions.explanation: Showing strong motivation and enthusiasm; actively seeking to achieve or improve.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{意欲的|いよくてき}に{仕事|しごと}に{取|と}り{組|く}んでいる。
examples.english: He is tackling work with great motivation.

examples.japanese: {意欲的|いよくてき}な{学生|がくせい}を{求|もと}めています。
examples.english: We are looking for motivated students.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいプロジェクトに{意欲的|いよくてき}に{参加|さんか}した。
examples.english: I eagerly participated in the new project.

examples.japanese: {意欲的|いよくてき}な{姿勢|しせい}が{評価|ひょうか}された。
examples.english: The motivated attitude was highly evaluated.

notes:
USAGE: {意欲的|いよくてき} is commonly used in work and academic contexts to describe someone who actively engages with tasks. Can be used as な-adjective or adverbially with に.

NOUN: {意欲|いよく} (motivation, enthusiasm, will)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{意欲的|いよくてき}に{取|と}り{組|く}む (tackle enthusiastically)
・{意欲的|いよくてき}な{姿勢|しせい} (motivated attitude)
・{意欲的|いよくてき}な{作品|さくひん} (ambitious work)
・{意欲的|いよくてき}に{挑戦|ちょうせん}する (eagerly take on challenges)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{積極的|せっきょくてき}: Proactive, assertive (emphasis on taking initiative)
・{意欲的|いよくてき}: Ambitious, motivated (emphasis on strong desire)
・やる{気|き}がある: To be motivated (casual expression)
